name: sentinel-health-ai
description: Root manager for running all 4 modules of Sentinel-Health AI simultaneously

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix api-gateway && npm install --prefix sentinel-dashboard
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others -n "gateway,ml,prescr,dashbd" -c "cyan,green,magenta,blue" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:prescription" "npm run dev:dashboard"
